note: The two sets are nearly identical in content and share the same errors: both misread the first edgewise structural damping as 5% (the page states 3%, 3%, 6%) and both carry a garbled, misbound 'flatback surface | midpoint definition' claim. Both also duplicate the normalized arc-length endpoint facts under two entity names and repeat figure-label trivia. The only difference is that A keeps 'following the curved blade reference axis' inside the composite-layer definition while B moves it to a conditions field — both are faithful, so neither gains an advantage.
remarks: Both sets quote the damping sentence as '3%, 5%, and 6%' whereas the page (text layer and image) reads '3%, 3%, and 6%'; the edgewise value 5% is therefore wrong in both. The 'flatback surface | midpoint definition | normalized arc length position' claim is unsupported/misbound in both — the page defines the trailing edge (not a normalized position) as the midpoint of the flatback surface, and its quote is truncated/garbled. The suction-side s=0 quote is also garbled ('position ero at...'). Figure 2-7 labels (Plane of Rotation, Chord Line, Pitch Axis, Arc Width, Offset, θrot) are extracted as trivial 'has component/has property' claims in both sets. Both sets also miss the tool-chain facts (PreComp/VABS/BECAS computing stiffness matrices used in OpenFAST/HAWC2).
